about: Delegation cases for scripts/prompt-eval.mjs. A synthetic town shaped like a real one (a Mayor, five directors with reports, roads from each director to its reports). Case texts are paraphrases of real delegation pairs, not copied messages; expect is the cat the real town handed that kind of work to.

founders.name: Mayor
founders.role: Coordinate the town. Delegate by expertise, summarize results, and bring owner-only decisions to the owner.

founders.name: Scholar
founders.role: Research opportunities: markets, niches and competitors, with sources and stated confidence.

founders.name: Archivist
founders.role: Summarize evidence and lessons with provenance, and record what finished work established for the town's memory.

projects.name: Director Shop
reports: Researcher for the sticker shop: competitor prices, popular niches and seasonal demand
Merchant drafter for the sticker shop: product listings, descriptions and bundle offers
Critic for the sticker shop: checks listings for claims, typos and policy problems before anything goes live

projects.name: Director Game
projects.project: Puzzle Game: browser puzzle game with a paid hint pack
reports: Builder for the puzzle game: writes the code, fixes bugs and deploys previews
Critic for the puzzle game: reviews balance, difficulty and release readiness

projects.name: Director Video
projects.project: App Videos: short videos advertising the app
reports: Script writer for the app videos: hooks, scripts and captions
Builder for the app videos: renders videos from approved scripts
Critic for the app videos: checks scripts and renders for wrong claims and caption mistakes

projects.name: Director Course
projects.project: Cooking Course: paid online cooking course
reports: Writer for the cooking course: lesson plans, outlines, FAQ and sign-up page drafts
Critic for the cooking course: reviews lessons for safety, clarity and honest claims

projects.name: Director News
projects.project: Newsletter: weekly newsletter about the app
reports: Writer for the newsletter: weekly issues, subject lines and referral offers
Critic for the newsletter: proofreads issues and flags weak claims

history: Compared prices of five sticker sellers

cases.text: The sticker shop needs three new product listings for the holiday range.
Add a hint button and a daily puzzle to the browser game.
Make one more short video showing how a goal turns into tasks.
Write the lesson plan for week two of the cooking course.
Put together this week's newsletter about the new features.
How are sticker sales going? Have the shop team check our price list against competitors.
Level three of the game is too hard and players quit. Fix the balance.
Turn the cooking course outline into a sign-up page draft.
Have the video team script a 20-second clip about the town's diary.
The newsletter needs three subject line options to test.
Summarize what the town learned from last month's work, with sources, for the records.
Research three markets we have not tried yet for a new money project.
Goal round 4: Make money with the sticker shop. Next step: price the new holiday bundles.
Goal round 7: Advertise the app with short videos. Next step: render the second video.
Goal round 2: Grow the newsletter to 500 readers. Next step: draft a referral offer.

Goal round 5: Sell the cooking course. Next step: write the course FAQ.
Goal round 9: Advertise the app with short videos. Director Video is busy, so ask Video Critic directly to review the draft script.
Goal round 15: Make the puzzle game earn money. Director Game is busy, so ask Game Builder directly to fix the broken save button.
